texts.zh: 我们的人员一直在努力促进与斯克兰德和他的船员的关系。这种跨文化交流的努力已经取得初步成效：刚刚斯克兰德同意提供他们高效舰载机的设计。这可能会大大提升我们对太空作战的理解。
texts.en: Our personnel have worked hard to foster relations with Skrand and his crewmates. This effort in cross-cultural exchange is already bearing fruit: Skrand has just agreed to hand over the designs for their highly efficient strike craft. This could lead to a great leap in our understanding of space combat.

label.en: We are thankful for this gift.
